content:
irina: Heads up — after the OIDC claim rename (department -> dept) our SCIM group sync is flapping in prod, several users removed from infra-admins then re-added. RBAC alerts firing. Anyone seen this pattern?

alex.s: Ugh. Did we update the SCIM attribute mappings in the IdP? Changing claim name without updating SCIM filter will cause mismatches.

irina: We updated the OIDC claims in the IdP this morning at ~09:20. We thought SCIM uses 'department' claim for group assignment, but IdP now sends 'dept'. SCIM logs show 404s on group lookups.

samir: Can you paste a provisioning log snippet from the SCIM worker?

irina: Sure — here's the error when it tries to resolve group by externalId:
```
2024-06-15T09:27:42Z ERROR scim-provisioner: group lookup failed: api/v2/Groups?filter=externalId eq "dept:infra-admins" -> 404 Not Found
2024-06-15T09:27:42Z WARN scim-provisioner: creating fallback group "infra-admins" local cache ttl expired
```

alex.s: That "dept:infra-admins" externalId looks wrong — our externalId format was `department:groupname`. The IdP change broke prefixing. Check mapping in IdP SCIM app (maybe the template changed variable name).

idp-bot: SAML/OIDC config webhook: metadata refreshed for okta-app-7 at 2024-06-15T09:18:00Z

samir: Also check SCIM worker environment variables — did we roll a new worker container with old mapping? `SCIM_GROUP_EXTID_TEMPLATE` could be stale.

irina: Checking now... in prod we have `SCIM_GROUP_EXTID_TEMPLATE=department:%{group}` — indeed that won't match new `dept` claim. But why would IdP start sending `dept:groupname` instead of `department`? We didn't change externalId template on our side.

alex.s: IdP could be using new claim prefix — go to Okta > Profile Editor > App > Mappings and look at the `Group` attribute settings.

irina: Found it. Someone updated the Okta attribute mapping earlier this morning; the mapping template changed from `department` -> `dept` when they migrated a legacy attribute. They didn't update the SCIM mapping or tell us. :facepalm: 

sec-oncall: OK — immediate mitigations: 1) Pause SCIM provisioning jobs for affected app to stop thrash. 2) Revert IdP mapping to `department` or 3) update our `SCIM_GROUP_EXTID_TEMPLATE` and redeploy with careful rollout + canary.

irina: Pausing jobs now — `POST /internal/admin/scim/pause?app=okta-app-7` -> 200 OK

ops-bot: [action] scim sync paused for okta-app-7 by irina at 2024-06-15T09:35:10Z

samir: Before changing our template, confirm no other tenants rely on `dept`. If multiple SaaS apps use the same claim name we might break them.

alex.s: Suggestion: prefer making our matching tolerant — accept both `department:` and `dept:` prefixes during a 24h migration window. Quick patch in SCIM normalizer: try regex `^(department|dept):(.+)$`.

irina: I can push a patch to canary workers in eu-west-1 now. Will also open an RFC for "IdP attribute change checklist" so this doesn't repeat.

sec-oncall: Good. Also file an audit log entry linking to incident. We need KMS logs for keys used when creating fallback groups? Might be relevant for compliance review.

samir: KMS usage is logged in vault-audit; I can pull the envelope log for the timeframe. But note SCIM fallback group creation doesn't encrypt group names — only secrets.

irina: Canary patch pushed to eu-west-1: `git rev: d4c3b2a` — enabling tolerant prefix parsing. Rolling to 2 instances.

ops-bot: deploy success: scim-provisioner d4c3b2a -> 2/2 healthy (eu-west-1)

alex.s: Monitor for remaining flapping and any duplicate group creations. If flapping stops, we can schedule the IdP rollback or full mapping update during the maintenance window.

irina: After canary, group flapping rate dropped from ~18/hr to 0. Re-enabling sync in 10m to reconcile current state.

ops-bot: scim sync resumed for okta-app-7 at 2024-06-15T10:05:12Z

idp-bot: Alert: Okta mapping change detected earlier; owner @luis.did this change

irina: Thanks — looping in @luis to coordinate permanent fix.

luis: Sorry folks — I messed up the mapping when I consolidated attributes. I can revert now or we can keep the new claim and update SCIM. Prefer latter if you made tolerant parsing.

samir: Let's keep tolerant parsing, then update our SCIM template to `dept` and roll. Also add regression test in provisioning E2E harness that simulates claim rename.

irina: Created ticket SEC-2741: "SCIM: support dept/department claim migration + IdP checklist" and added link to audit logs and KMS query notes.

sec-oncall: Closing loop: mitigation applied, canary healthy, owner notified. Recommend postmortem with follow-ups: idp change SOP, SCIM resiliency test, audit log retention check.

irina: Thanks all. :tada:
